meta.name: jewelcore-aurum
meta.description: Clean and modern jewellery management UI — warm paper neutrals, rich antique-gold accent, dark ink sidebar, glass surfaces, Sora display + Inter body. Designed for the shopkeeper: calm, premium, information-dense without noise.
source_references: user brief: 'clean and modern' (no screenshots provided, feature-extracted from described style)

neutral.usage: warm paper background with white cards; ink text; warm-gray borders

color.contrast_strategy: dark-on-light dominant; gold gradients carry dark ink text to hold WCAG AA

typography.font_style_notes: geometric display head for headings, humanist body for data; tabular numerals for prices/weights

spacing.section_rhythm: 24px between cards, 32px between page sections, 20px inside cards

layout.alignment_tendency: mixed — strict grid for data, asymmetric for hero stats

shape.border_usage: subtle 1px warm borders on cards and inputs, none inside tables

elevation.depth_cues: shadows + color intensity (no glass on cards, glass reserved for topbar)

motion.philosophy: minimal functional — moves only where it signals state

components.button_style: primary: gold gradient + ink text; secondary: gold-soft; ghost: ink on hover
components.input_style: rounded-md, 1px border, 2px gold focus ring, no inner shadow
components.card_style: white, 1px hairline, soft diffused shadow, 16px radius
components.navigation_pattern: dark ink rail, gold gradient active pill, section overlines
components.modal_style: centered sheet, glass overlay, slide-up, 16px radius
components.component_notes: tables keep visible header strip; page headers show title extrabold with tracking

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: a jeweller's bench — quiet gold on soft felt

visual_language.whitespace_usage: generous card padding, tight data rows
visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: heavy on values and CTAs, light on chrome
visual_language.focal_strategy: progressive reveal — hero stats first, secondary detail below
visual_language.texture_usage: none on paper; gradient light sheen on brand surfaces

imagery.illustration_style: line-art lucide icons with soft tint tiles
imagery.graphic_elements: gold gradient orbs on auth panels

interaction_feel.feedback_style: instant: full-target scrolling, pressed scale, gold glow on hover

overview.fallback_strategy: prefers-reduced-motion disables drift/orb animation; effects degrade to static gradients

background_effects.description: Dual gold light orbs drifting slowly behind the auth panel and sidebar brand tile

text_effects.description: Gold gradient wordmark in sidebar brand tile

svg_animations.description: Slow rotating conic she ring behind the auth brand mark

visual_effects.composite_notes: All effects are CSS-only for a low-power POS environment; shimmer keyframe preserved for skeletons; motion wound obediently under prefers-reduced-motion.
